_note: Brand profiles the content & design studio writes for. Add real client brands with /brandkit add — runtime additions land in outputs/proposal_pool/brands_extra.json and are committed by the daily pool workflow. Never let an agent invent a field: leave it blank and it will ask.

brands.positioning: The Intelligence of Creativity — a strategy-led agency that ships campaigns and events with agency-grade rigour at a challenger's speed.
brands.products: Brand strategy, content retainers, campaign management, paid media, video production, event management (flagship: IGNITE Myanmar Business Summit)
brands.target_audience: Founders and marketing leads at Myanmar SMEs and regional brands who are tired of agencies that deliver posts instead of results
audience_segments: Myanmar SME owners (F&B, retail, property, education) spending 1-5M MMK/month on marketing
Marketing managers at Myanmar corporates and banks who need a partner that can present to a board
Singapore SMEs and startups entering or expanding in Southeast Asia
brands.audience_insight: They can buy content anywhere. What they cannot buy locally is someone who connects the content to a number they care about — and can prove it monthly.
brands.tone: Premium, confident, data-driven, strategic, concise. Sharp and intelligent, never fluffy.
brands.avoid: Generic agency-speak, hype, emoji-heavy captions, cliches ('take your brand to the next level'), salesy urgency, overclaiming unverified numbers
brands.fonts: Headline: a confident geometric sans. Body: Calibri in documents, Pyidaungsu for Myanmar text.
brands.logo_notes: Gold on navy is the standard lockup. Keep clear space of one logo height. Never place the logo on a busy photo without a scrim.
brands.visual_style: Editorial and restrained — real work, real people, generous negative space, one gold accent per frame. No stock-photo handshakes.
brands.offers: Content retainers 8/10/16/30 posts per month; campaign and event management; IGNITE sponsorship packages
brands.compliance: Never quote an unverified vendor rate as fact. All money figures use market FX, sell side. Nothing sends externally without MD approval.
brands.notes: ZYNTH's own profile — used when the studio produces content for the agency itself. Client brands are added separately.
